checks.detail: Strategy config, candidates, comparison, review, brief and variant contracts are versioned.
Candidate admission and comparison are deterministic for the same exact input snapshot; review signals are DB-first and first-wins.
L1 Gate 2 fails closed and publishes exact Creative Brief and Variant Plan pointers.
CandidateBudget and VariantPlan enforce generation, token, cost and variant limits before execution.
Legally usable multi-genre strategy gold corpus and editor labels have not been provided.
No controlled exposure, retention or completion data exists for Hook calibration.
E06 provider production qualification remains rejected/pending human.
No real Approved Story and Gate 2 decision have been signed by the project owner.
Real multi-project Worker restart, queue saturation and DB contention require production-like data and runtime validation.

severe_errors.description: A selling point or Hook asserts content unsupported by Approved Story evidence.
A deterministic blocker is overridden by score or reviewer payload.
Opening withholds information without a grounded continuation/payoff.
Narrative spine changes identity, event, causality or outcome from Approved Story.
Creative direction violates hard safety, platform or rights constraints.
Approved strategy cannot satisfy the frozen duration or cost ceiling.
Unexposed candidate variants are reported as a validated experiment.
